_meta.what: V3 comparator country-salience series in the Caldara-Iacoviello country-index tradition: ONE shared geopolitical-risk vocabulary, anchored per country, so cross-country comparison is apples-to-apples by construction. India runs through the same instrument for comparability; the five-channel index remains the primary product. Ex-ante rule and query grammar apply unchanged (tests/test_dictionaries.py).
_meta.construct_note: Shared terms are structural press vocabulary for geopolitical stress, never event names. Differences in press attention across countries include an Anglophone-coverage bias, disclosed; see the V5 audit plan.
